records.situation: A job can run on NODE-Z and needs US/VPN egress.
records.reasoning: First verify/obtain the general placement lease. Then let API Client independently resolve and reserve the required outbound route. Never treat spare capacity or local convenience as permission to weaken the route.

records.situation: A browser session is valid but its required VPN disappears.
records.reasoning: Keep placement/browser state conceptually separate. Return route/egress failure for that operation; do not silently relocate the job or weaken the route.

records.situation: The node capability generation changes while a browser timer is about to fetch.
records.reasoning: Revalidate placement before the side effect. Suspend/fail if the allocator would no longer verify the lease; do not infer validity from same node identity.

records.situation: Bulk source/news ingestion competes with interactive work.
records.reasoning: Keep WLU cost truthful. Reduce desired delivery rate and schedule priority for bulk traffic; do not fake lower work cost.

records.situation: An AI watching a browser wants to click a button.
records.reasoning: Observation returns state only. The AI must submit a separate authorised Virtual Browser command; never add mutation to the neutral Observation query plane.
Route through Virtual Browser host authority and API Client. The ECMAScript engine never receives a bypass socket.

records.situation: Allocator replaces a failed execution node.
records.reasoning: Job replacement does not automatically authorize transfer of authenticated browser state. Apply separate state-migration policy or restart from a semantic checkpoint.

records.situation: HTML references analytics, images and fonts irrelevant to the job.
records.reasoning: Suppress them at Virtual Browser resource policy before API Client admission. Do not spend remote bandwidth/WLU merely to imitate a visual consumer browser.

records.situation: A web app polls every 250 ms.
records.reasoning: Virtual Browser may clamp polling to a policy minimum. API Client remains final outbound admission/rate authority.

records.situation: A native ECMAScript binding exposes size_t or long.
records.reasoning: Use Foreign Runtime ABI-native scalar aliases and require abi-native-c-scalars; do not guess fixed widths or claim unqualified ABI struct layouts.
